about_short_description.short_description: Phygrid provides software solutions for workforce management, virtual collaboration, and digital productivity tools.

product.name: Phygrid Edge AI Infrastructure
product.description: A unified platform that powers and manages edge AI devices, applications, and analytics for physical-world environments at scale.

product.name: Phygrid Appointment Booking
product.description: A scheduling system that manages customer appointments and integrates with other retail solutions to optimize service flow.

product.name: Phygrid Click & Collect
product.description: A solution for managing online order pickups with flexible retrieval options and enhanced customer communication.

product.name: Phygrid Digital Signage
product.description: A platform for managing digital displays to communicate promotions, information, and personalized content in physical spaces.

product.name: Phygrid Endless Aisle
product.description: An interactive retail solution that expands product availability by enabling customers to browse and order items beyond physical inventory.

product.name: Phygrid Food Ordering
product.description: A multi-channel digital food ordering system supporting kiosks, mobile apps, QR/NFC table ordering, and real-time notifications.
